---

name: oddscreeners-icon-guidelines

description: Icon usage guidelines for ODDScreeners. Functional, minimal, and consistent icons for trading dashboards (Discover, Arbitrage, Wallet Tracker).

---



\## Purpose

Ensure icons in ODDScreeners improve clarity and usability without breaking visual consistency or performance.

Icons are supportive UI elements, not decorative assets.



\## Core principles

\- Icons are functional, not artistic

\- Clarity > creativity

\- Consistency across the entire product

\- Icons should never compete with data



\## Icon style rules

\- Prefer simple, outline-style icons

\- Avoid filled, illustrated, or 3D-style icons

\- Keep stroke weight consistent across all icons

\- Avoid mixing multiple icon styles in the same view



\## Icon size \& readability

\- Primary icon sizes:

&nbsp; - 12px: inline indicators

&nbsp; - 14px–16px: buttons, table actions

&nbsp; - 18px–20px: primary actions only

\- Icons must remain clearly recognizable at small sizes

\- Avoid thin strokes that disappear on dark backgrounds



\## Icon usage guidelines

\- Icons should support text, not replace it

\- Do not use icon-only buttons unless:

&nbsp; - the action is extremely common

&nbsp; - a tooltip or aria-label is provided

\- Avoid stacking multiple icons together unless necessary



\## Tables \& lists

\- Use icons sparingly in data tables

\- Icons in tables should:

&nbsp; - indicate actions (external link, calculate, expand)

&nbsp; - indicate status (bonus, warning, resolved)

\- Do NOT use icons to decorate table rows or titles



\## Buttons \& actions

\- Action buttons may include icons, but text must remain primary

\- Icon + text alignment must be consistent across buttons

\- Avoid oversized icons inside buttons



\## Status \& semantic icons

\- Icons can reinforce meaning:

&nbsp; - 🔗 external link

&nbsp; - ⚠️ warning / attention

&nbsp; - 🎁 bonus indicator

\- Color should reinforce meaning, but icon shape must still be clear without color



\## Accessibility

\- All icon-only buttons must have:

&nbsp; - aria-label

&nbsp; - title or tooltip

\- Icons should not be the sole indicator of critical information

\- Ensure sufficient contrast against background



\## Mobile considerations

\- Icons must remain tappable and legible on mobile

\- Avoid reducing icon size too aggressively on small screens

\- Touch targets should meet minimum size (44px), even if icon itself is smaller



\## What NOT to do

\- Do not introduce custom-drawn or illustrative icons

\- Do not redesign iconography without explicit instruction

\- Do not use icons for purely decorative purposes

\- Do not mix icon styles across different sections



\## Output expectations

When applying this skill:

\- Prefer existing icon sets over inventing new ones

\- Explain why an icon improves clarity or usability

\- Keep icon changes incremental and reversible

\- Respect existing UI and UX guidelines
